AN ADJOURNED MEETING OF THE LA HABRA HEIGHTS CITY COUNCIL
1245 North Hacienda Road
La Habra Heights, California
Closed Session
06:00 p.m. Regular Business
November 19, 2020
The City of La Habra Heights complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990. If you require special assistance to attend or participate in this meeting, please call the City Clerk's office at (562) 694-6302 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Materials related to any items on this agenda submitted to the Council after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office at 1245 N. Hacienda Road, La Habra Heights, CA 90631 during normal business hours.
PUBLIC COMMENT PROCESS
The City Council will listen to the public on any numbered item on the agenda or any item that is not on the agenda but relevant to City business. The City Council cannot legally take action on any item not scheduled on the agenda. Such items may be referred for administrative action or scheduled on a future agenda. If you wish to speak to the Council, please complete a Speaker's Card and present it before the agenda item is called. You will be called to the podium by name when it is your turn to speak to the Council. Should you need to provide written documentation to the City, please give the City Manager a minimum of nine (9) copies prior to the start of the meeting so the information can be distributed appropriately. Comments will generally be limited to three minutes per speaker. However, a shorter limit may be declared by the Mayor for agenda items for which many Speaker Cards have been submitted.
Public Comment For Items On The Agenda: Speakers will be called on in the order cards were received.
Public Comment For Items Not On The Agenda: Persons wishing to speak on agenda items will be called at the time the agenda item is brought forward.
